What is inside my QR?




Kit: 3 STL colour parts + 1 assembled 3MF + your settings.
STL does not store colours. Import the parts together as one object.


One print. Two sides.
Print QR up, front on the bed. Try a 0.20 mm first layer, then 0.10 mm layers. Use your own printer profile and purge settings. Supports and flipping are not needed.
vCard recognition depends on your scanner. Always confirm the saved contact and test physical scanning before printing a batch.
